themes_detail.label: Street Signs Vanishing
themes_detail.summary: Street sign complaints spiked to 4 reports this week versus a baseline of 0.4 per week (900% increase, z-score 5.21), suggesting coordinated theft, vandalism, or municipal neglect affecting navigation and safety in Coney Island/Brighton Beach.
evidence: 4 complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (967% spike, z-score 5.21)
Sustained pattern: obstruction complaints also up 900% last week (5 vs. 0.5 avg), suggesting broader street infrastructure issues
Street condition complaints up 216% this week (28 vs. 8.9 weekly avg), indicating compounding infrastructure deterioration
reporting_angles: Are street signs being systematically stolen or removed for development projects (note: 5 active ULURPs in district)?
What is DOT's response time to missing signage in CD 313 versus other Brooklyn districts?

themes_detail.label: Sewage System Strain
themes_detail.summary: Sewer complaints jumped to 13 reports this week versus a baseline of 4.6 per week (181% increase, z-score 3.95), potentially indicating blockages, infrastructure failure, or storm surge residue in a low-lying waterfront district.
evidence: 13 sewer complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 4.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (181% spike, z-score 3.95)
Water System complaints also elevated in 90-day data (250 total), suggesting interconnected water/sewage stress
Coney Island/Brighton Beach are flood-prone neighborhoods; recent weather events or tide patterns may have triggered failures
reporting_angles: Has recent weather (coastal storms, high tides, or freeze-thaw cycles) overwhelmed aging sewer infrastructure?
Are residents experiencing backup, odors, or property damage? Seek affected homeowners and renters.

themes_detail.label: Street Deterioration Accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints surged to 28 this week versus an 8-week average of 8.9 per week (216% increase, z-score 3.8), suggesting potholes, cracking, or subsidence worsening across the district.
evidence: 28 street condition complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 8.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (216% spike, z-score 3.8)
Converges with spike in missing street signs (4 complaints this week), obstruction (5 last week), and dumpster complaints (3 last week), all indicating deteriorating public realm
Snow/ice complaints (498 over 90 days) suggest freeze-thaw damage; winter conditions may be accelerating street failure
reporting_angles: Which neighborhoods within Coney Island/Brighton Beach have the worst streets? Map the complaints geographically.
What is DOT's repair queue and timeline? Is funding insufficient relative to demand?

themes_detail.label: Tree Canopy Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Damaged and dead/dying tree complaints spiked 700–1100% over the past 3 weeks (4 damaged trees 3 weeks ago, 3 dead/dying trees 2 weeks ago, versus 0.5 and 0.2 weekly baselines respectively), indicating possible disease, storm damage, or neglect affecting the district's environmental health.
evidence: Damaged Tree complaints: 4 reports 3 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 7.0)
Dead/Dying Tree complaints: 3 reports 2 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score 6.35)
Combined signal: at least 7 tree-related complaints in 2 weeks suggests disease outbreak, recent storm, or systematic neglect by Parks Dept.
reporting_angles: Is a specific tree species affected (e.g., ash borers, salt-spray damage, root rot) in this coastal district?
What is Parks Department's response and tree maintenance budget for CD 313?

themes_detail.label: Dumpster/Sanitation Overflow
themes_detail.summary: Dumpster complaints spiked to 3 this week versus a baseline of 0.2 per week (1100% increase, z-score 6.35), potentially indicating inadequate waste management, illegal dumping, or deferred collection affecting public health in a high-density area.
evidence: 3 dumpster complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1100% spike, z-score 6.35)
Converges with broader sanitation concerns: 'Unsanitary Condition' (255 complaints over 90 days) and 'Dirty Condition' (183) rank high in overall volume
May be linked to development activity: 5 ULURPs in progress could be generating construction debris
reporting_angles: Are construction projects from active ULURPs (The Coney Development, Seaside Park rezoning) creating debris overflow?
Is DSNY collection frequency adequate for this district's density? Are residents facing health hazards?
